name: Rio After Dark
status: Default rendering direction and palette accepted; subject, use, style overrides and branding controlled by the operator.

rendering.name: GTA6-inspired illustrated poster
rendering.description: Semi-realistic proportions, deliberate hand-painted contours, graphic tonal shapes, cinematic light and polished commercial game-poster energy. Keep the focal subject readable, with concentrated vivid color and clear depth.
rendering.iconAdaptation: Retain the illustrated contours, tonal separation and selected palette, with a simplified isolated subject and fewer details. A full scenic background is not required.

paletteGuidance: Use the palette as a coherent default, not a quota requiring every color. Preserve natural skin/fur where relevant. Users may alter colors and the overall rendering style. These artwork defaults do not certify website design-system compliance.
subjectPolicy: Operator-supplied theme and main elements. No mandatory person, casino object, sports object, mascot, clothing, geographic setting, or brand.
compositionPolicy: Derive composition from the operator's image ratio and width, or icon specification. No fixed website slot, text zone, button zone, or required edge fade.
brandingDefault: Do not add extra brand marks unless requested. This applies equally to PK.GAME and other brands.

references.provenance: User-selected illustration from the earlier artwork work
references.use: Observe illustrated realism, pink/cyan lighting and tonal depth. The person, clothing, Rio setting and wide composition are examples, not defaults for every task.

references.role: Optional object and material illustration reference
references.use: Observe illustrated object surfaces and the pink/cyan palette. Do not inherit the slot machine, left copy area, or layout unless requested.
Observe object contours, readable shapes and coordinated light. Do not inherit football elements, the court, or layout unless requested.

updatePolicy: Per-task overrides do not modify this snapshot. Explicit shared-default updates create a new theme version and package.
